description: Sends a weekly HTML digest email every Monday at 8am with leads, subscribers, chat conversations, and analytics stats from the last 7 days.
name: AEJaCA Weekly Digest

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS leads_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads) AS leads_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscribers WHERE unsubscribed = FALSE AND subscribed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS subs_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscribers WHERE unsubscribed = FALSE) AS subs_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS convs_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hot_lead = TRUE) FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS hot_leads_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) FROM events WHERE ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS visitors_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE category = 'page' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS pageviews_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) FROM events WHERE category = 'inquiry' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS inquiries_week,
  (SELECT path FROM events WHERE category = 'page' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY path ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_page
